scope: CPU-only opt-in exact shared-key gadget and native automorphism batches. Default replay behavior remains unchanged. No new encryption or key generation.
unit_coverage: Gadget batches compare all coefficients with the original RNS kernel across one-, four- and eight-column tiles and partial windows, zero/mixed rows, scalar CRT prime counts, nested callers and shape guards. Small rings also use independent cpp_int negacyclic convolution. Native batches compare with digit NTT at N16/512/16384, both112/145 chunks, data levels398/385/165/121, in-place calls and dispatch guards. Factor checks cover three/four-column callback selection, fallback groups and exception propagation.
controls: One process reuses the same retained input and loaded prepared key caches. Warm legacy, full-team independent and coordinated batch; measure legacy/team/batch/batch/team/legacy. Full-team control uses original single-switch arithmetic, separating its scheduling from shared batch arithmetic.
